title: Build a career in commercial casework.
intro: We're a family-owned commercial cabinet shop in North Richland Hills, building and installing casework for schools, hospitals, restaurants and offices across North Texas. We're always looking for skilled people, and for people who want to learn the trade.
whyTitle: A shop that invests in its people

why.title: Steady commercial work
why.text: Year-round projects for schools, healthcare and businesses across DFW.

why.title: Modern equipment
why.text: CNC machining, edgebanding and barcode tracking on every job.

why.title: Room to grow
why.text: Start as a helper and train into assembly, machining or installation.

why.title: Family owned
why.text: A local team where you know the owner and your work is noticed.

openingsTitle: We're always hiring for these positions
openingsIntro: These roles stay open year-round. Apply anytime, and we'll reach out when there's a fit.
